title: Hydraulic ironworkers and punching machines
subtitle: HKM single- and double-piston ironworkers 44 – 193 US tons · HPM hydraulic punches to 193 US tons · HPM DP, HPM CNC and NC punching lines
about_title: Five stations on one machine — punch, shear, notch, cut angle and bar
about_text: The machines in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line: built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification by a CE-certified metal-forming plant with more than 40 years of machine building and exports to over 100 countries, with European hydraulic and electrical components, inspected before shipping, and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

The HKM ironworkers put the five jobs of the structural shop on one machine: punching, round and square bar shear, angle shear, flat-bar and sheet shear and rectangular notching, each with its own station and LED light — single-piston machines from the 44 US ton HKM 40 to the 193 US ton HKM 175, and double-piston machines with two cylinders and two pedals so two operators work at once. The HPM hydraulic punching machines make round, oblong and shaped holes in plate, angle and sections in one stroke — bench-height 33 and 44 ton punches, 72 to 193 ton machines with a 24.6″ throat, double-head HPM DP, the HPM CNC with a Siemens-controlled table and the NC lines that copy hole patterns along angles, flat bar and beams. Punches and dies interchange across the range.
